items.name: Bread
items.desc: A heel of dark bread. Filling.

items.name: Green gem
items.desc: A small green stone from the quarry. You never mentioned it to Garran.

items.name: Crab meat
items.desc: Sweet white meat, cracked out of the shell.

items.name: Field mushrooms
items.desc: Pale caps from the woods. You're fairly sure they're the safe kind.

items.name: Hazelnuts
items.desc: A pocketful, cracked with a stone.

items.name: Samphire
items.desc: Salty green stems from the marsh edge.

enemies.name: Yellow-eyed wolf
enemies.desc: A starved grey wolf, all ribs and matted fur. Its eyes have gone the colour of old pus, and it doesn't blink.

moves.name: snaps at you
moves.tell: It circles you, snapping at the air.

moves.name: lunges at your throat
moves.tell: It drops low and its back legs bunch. It's going to lunge.

moves.name: backs off, hackles up
moves.tell: It backs off a step, watching your hands. It's ready for you.

enemies.name: Rock crab
enemies.desc: A crab the size of a dinner plate, barnacled and old. One claw is far bigger than the other, and there's a yellow crust where its eyes should shine.

moves.name: pinches at your ankle
moves.tell: It sidles towards you, big claw open.

moves.name: clamps its big claw on you
moves.tell: It rears up and raises both claws high.

moves.name: hunkers down behind its shell
moves.tell: It pulls its legs in and hunkers behind its shell.

classes.name: Adventurer
classes.desc: Travelling, surviving and fighting. More stamina for the road.

classes.name: Blacksmith
classes.desc: Crafting, mining and defence. Stronger arms.

classes.name: Mage
classes.desc: Magic, intellect and enchanting. A sharper mind.

backgrounds.name: Desk job
backgrounds.desc: Eight hours a day of screens and spreadsheets.

backgrounds.name: Weekend runner
backgrounds.desc: The one thing you did for yourself.

backgrounds.name: Night shifts
backgrounds.desc: Long hours on your feet while everyone else slept.

backgrounds.name: Shop floor
backgrounds.desc: Smiling at people who never smiled back.

gear.name: Gutting knife
gear.desc: Yenson's spare. Made for fish, not fights, but it has a point.

gear.name: Iron knife
gear.desc: Plain and sharp, and you made it.

gear.name: Hide buckler
gear.desc: A small round shield of boiled hide on an iron rim.

gear.name: Reinforced work gloves
gear.desc: Leather with iron studs across the knuckles.

gear.name: Salt-stiff shirt
gear.desc: Your own shirt, stiff with dried seawater and torn at one sleeve.

gear.name: Torn trousers
gear.desc: Good cloth once. The sea and the rocks have had their way with them.

gear.name: Salt-stained boots
gear.desc: They squelch less than they did, which is something.

gear.name: Iron cap
gear.desc: A plain round cap of hammered iron. It won't stop much, but it'll stop something.

gear.name: Leather jerkin
gear.desc: Thick, laced leather that turns a claw or a glancing blade.

gear.name: Leather boots
gear.desc: Tall boots of oiled leather. Dry feet, steady footing.

gear.name: Bone charm
gear.desc: A carved bone on a leather cord. Fishermen here wear them against the sea.

gear.name: Copper ring
gear.desc: A plain copper band, gone green at the edges.

gear.name: Woodcutter's axe
gear.desc: A long-hafted axe made for felling trees. It takes both hands, and it hits like it.

traits.name: Balanced
traits.desc: Sits well in the hand. The timing bar's sweet spot is wider.

traits.name: Warded
traits.desc: Holds back a little of the corruption's growth on you.

traits.name: Kindled
traits.desc: Every hit carries a little fire.

traits.name: Sturdy
traits.desc: Blocks a little more of every hit.

traits.name: Swift
traits.desc: Helps you act before your enemy.

traits.name: Hardy
traits.desc: More stamina to work and fight with.

materials.name: Green gem
materials.desc: Your green quarry gem is set in the {part}.

spells.name: Draw Water
spells.desc: Pull water out of the air. Refills your waterskin; puts out small fires.

spells.name: Kindle
spells.desc: A spark of fire. Lights fires, and stings in a fight.

journal.text: Follow the coast road to the village Yenson told you about.
Help the hunters at the lodge: firewood, water and food.
Help Garran the blacksmith get his forge going again.
Visit old Orlen, the retired mage.
Go to the class stone at the guild post and choose your path.
Skelmed needs more help than you can give it here. Head for the nearest town.

regions.name: North-west Loran
regions.night: It's dark. You can hear the sea better than you can see the ground.

places.name: Yenson's shack
places.desc: Yenson's chimney smokes. The coast road runs north from his door, between gorse and the grey edge of the sea.
places.note: The fisherman who pulled you out of the sea. His fire is always lit.

places.name: The tide pools
places.desc: Black rocks run out into the sea here, pocked with pools. Weed hangs off everything.
places.note: Rock pools full of mussels, south of the headland.

choices.label: Search the tide pools
choices.result: You pick your way out over the weed-slick rocks. Most of the pools are empty, but you prise two handfuls of mussels off the stones before a wave soaks you to the knee.

places.name: The headland
places.desc: The road crests the headland. A sheep track leads off to the very top.
places.note: High ground over the coast road. You can see half of Loran from the top.

choices.label: Climb to the top for a look around

places.name: The stream
places.desc: The road fords a stream in a sheltered dip. Bramble bushes crowd the banks. Up ahead, roofs and a crooked harbour light: Skelmed.
places.note: Clean water and brambles, just south of Skelmed.

choices.label: Fill your waterskin at the stream
choices.result: The water is cold enough to hurt your teeth. You drink, then fill the skin.

choices.label: Pick blackberries
choices.result: Your hands come away scratched and stained purple, with three good handfuls of blackberries.

places.name: Skelmed
places.desc: The edge of the village. Grey cottages and a harbour far too big for them.
places.note: A fishing village that used to be a busy port. The guild, Garran's smithy and Orlen's cottage are here.

places.name: Garran's quarry
places.desc: A bite out of the hillside, cut in grey steps. Rusted wedges lie where the last crew dropped them.
places.note: Garran's old quarry in the hills east of Skelmed.

places.name: The hunters' camp
places.desc: A ring of stones and a lean-to at the edge of Brackenwood. The ashes are a few days cold.
places.note: Where Skelmed's hunters set out from, on the edge of Brackenwood.

places.name: Brennick
places.desc: A market town behind a wooden wall, where the trade road meets the north track. Smoke from a hundred chimneys.
places.note: The nearest town, east along the old trade road. The king's tax collector works from here.
places.rumour: Everyone in Skelmed talks about Brennick, the market town east along the trade road.
places.enterLabel: Go up to the town gate

places.name: Vael Bridge
places.desc: An old stone bridge over the Vael, three arches wide. Somebody has chiselled the king's crest off the keystone.
places.note: The old stone bridge over the river Vael, on the north track.

places.name: Eskholt
places.desc: A woodcutters' village of log halls, on the edge of the northern woods. Axes ring somewhere in the trees.
places.note: A woodcutters' village over the Vael.

places.name: Harrow Tower
places.desc: A broken watchtower on the crown of the hill. One wall still stands to its full height.
places.note: A ruined watchtower in the Harrow Hills, empty since the king pulled the road patrols.
places.rumour: A carter told you about Harrow Tower, an old watchtower in the hills north of the trade road.

places.name: Gloam Cave
places.desc: A cleft in a mossy bank, half hidden by roots. It smells of animal.
places.note: A cave in Brackenwood. Something lives in it.

places.name: The Old Stones
places.desc: A ring of standing stones in a clearing, deep in the forest. The trees don't grow close to them.
places.note: A ring of standing stones deep in the south-eastern forest.

places.name: Gullet Cove
places.desc: A narrow cove under the cliffs, with a strip of shingle that can't be seen from the road. There are keel marks in it.
places.note: A hidden cove down the coast. Smugglers land goods here to dodge the king's taxes.
places.rumour: A fisherman said boats come into a cove south of Yenson's place at night.

places.name: The Rotwood
places.desc: A grove gone grey and soft. Nothing sings here.
places.note: A blighted grove in the south-eastern forest. The Corruption has reached even here.

terrains.name: Road
terrains.title: On the road
terrains.desc: An old road, rutted and patched. Nobody has mended it in years.

terrains.name: Track
terrains.title: On a track
terrains.desc: A narrow track, trodden more by boots than wheels.

terrains.name: Bridge
terrains.title: At the crossing
terrains.desc: The water runs loud underneath you.

terrains.name: Beach
terrains.title: On the shore
terrains.desc: Shingle and wet sand. The sea throws weed and splinters up the beach.

terrains.name: Grassland
terrains.title: In open country
terrains.desc: Rough grass and gorse. Old field walls run through it, fallen in places. Nobody farms this now.

terrains.name: Hills
terrains.title: In the hills
terrains.desc: Bare hills and loose stone. Hard going, but you can see a long way from up here.

terrains.name: Forest
terrains.title: In the forest
terrains.desc: Close trees and dead bracken. You can't see far, and things can't see you either. Mostly.

terrains.name: Marsh
terrains.title: In the marsh
terrains.desc: Reeds, black water and sucking mud. Every step is work.

terrains.name: Blighted land
terrains.title: In blighted land
terrains.desc: The trees here are grey and soft, and the ground gives under you like something rotten. The mark on your wrist itches.
